testCommands.name: baseline
notes: PostgresDatabaseIT skipped because Docker/Testcontainers was unavailable.

testCommands.name: full-regression-audit
notes: The current FullTradingRegressionAuditTest is formula/service-level, not a full DB/API/frontend/ledger scenario.

steps.name: productType
missingItems: Provider instruments do not natively carry productType everywhere.
steps.recommendation: Keep provider instruments productType coverage aligned before deployment.

steps.name: AccountSnapshotService
missingItems: Perpetual snapshot valuation is not clearly mark-price first in AccountSnapshotService.
steps.recommendation: Reuse the mark-price recomputation path for perpetual account snapshots.

steps.name: Fee Notional
missingItems: TradeEntity/trading.trades do not persist generic fill-level fee, feeAsset, or notional fields.
Spot fee settlement is wallet asset-ledger based rather than cash TRADE_FEE ledger based.
steps.recommendation: Add per-fill fee/notional audit fields if reconciliation requires them.

steps.name: Wallet Schema
missingItems: Wallet numeric precision is NUMERIC(24,8), below the recommended 36,18.
steps.recommendation: Consider widening wallet precision before production crypto ledger use.

steps.name: Spot Wallet Settlement
missingItems: Frontend has fallback/mock balance behavior when wallet data is empty.
steps.recommendation: Keep fallback balances visibly separate from live wallet balances.

steps.name: PositionEngine
missingItems: No DB uniqueness or repair path for historical duplicate open net positions.
Reduce-only semantics are not fully covered.
steps.recommendation: Add a data repair or uniqueness strategy for open net positions.

steps.name: Perp Maintenance Margin
missingItems: Frontend PositionResponse type/display does not expose maintenanceMargin amount.
V34 migration backfills perpetual fields from asset_class rather than product_type.
steps.recommendation: Expose maintenanceMargin in frontend position rows and align migration backfill with product_type.

steps.name: FundingService
missingItems: Audit test does not explicitly cover inverse short positive funding.

steps.name: LiquidationService
missingItems: shouldLiquidate(AccountSnapshot) is narrower than scanAccount and does not include fresh mark recomputation or liquidation fee buffer.
Inverse liquidation fee account-vs-wallet currency handling needs reconciliation.
steps.recommendation: Make shouldLiquidate share the full scan risk model or document it as a shallow helper.

steps.name: FX Financing & Conversion
missingItems: OANDA-style gainQuoteHome/lossQuoteHome conversion factors remain TODO.
steps.recommendation: Keep docs/audit/fx-financing-basis.md as the current basis contract; add OANDA-style home conversion factors only if that broker-specific model becomes in scope.

notes: Coverage is formula/service-level and does not prove a full DB/API/frontend/ledger scenario for each product type.

p1Issues: AccountSnapshotService perpetual valuation is not clearly mark-price first.
Frontend does not expose backend maintenanceMargin amount for perpetual positions.
p2Issues: Trade rows lack generic per-fill fee, feeAsset, and notional audit fields.
Historical duplicate open net positions are not repaired or blocked by DB uniqueness.
Funding audit coverage should add inverse-short positive funding.
OANDA-style home conversion factors and conversion markup ledger are not implemented.
